title: Jayco, Inc.: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL (28 affected)
summary: THE GROSS AXLE WEIGHT RATING AND THE GROSS VEHICLE WEIGHT RATING ARE STATED INCORRECTLY ON THE CERTIFICATION LABEL.

title: THOMAS BUILT BUSES, INC.: VISUAL SYSTEMS:GLASS:WINDOW:REAR-VIEW BACKLIGHT (7,500 affected)
summary: THE CENTER ACTUATOR THAT RELEASES TWO CATCHES VIA TWO PULL RODS CAN BECOME NON-FUNCTIONAL FROM POOR OR IMPROPER MAINTENANCE, LACK OF LUBRICATION, CORROSION, OR A COMBINATION ALL THREE CAUSES.

title: AMERICAN SUNROOF CORP.: VISUAL SYSTEMS:SUN ROOF ASSEMBLY (8/82) (12,980 affected)
summary: THE FOUR SCREWS ATTACHING THE FRONT OF THE SLIDING GLASS PANEL TO THE MOVING SUPPORTING MECHANISM OF THE 400 SPOILER SUNROOF MAY LOOSEN AFTER INSTALLATION AND AFTER A PERIOD OF OPERATION.

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp., U.S.A.: BRAKES:MECHANICAL SERVICE:DISC BRAKES (1,760 affected)
summary: THE REAR BRAKE HOSE FROM THE MASTER CYLINDER TO THE CALIPER CAN CONTACT THE REAR DISC BRAKE, POSSIBLY ABRADING THE HOSE.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:PASSIVE RESTRAINT:BELTS (347,866 affected)
summary: THE FRONT DOOR SHOULDER BELT GUIDE LOOPS MAY BE CRACKED AND ARE NOT IN COMPLIANCE WITH FMVSS 208.

title: Atwood Mobile Products: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:STOVE (46,000 affected)
summary: THE ROBERTSHAW BURNER CONTROL VALVES WERE NOT ASSEMBLED WITH FASTENERS SET TO THE PROPER TORQUE SPECIFICATION.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:HOSE:FLUID (793 affected)
summary: THE STEEL BRAIDING ON THE POWER STEERING HOSE MAY ABRADE THE BATTERY CABLE.

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): EQUIPMENT:TIRE RESERVE LOAD LABEL (GLOVE COMPARTME (2,800 affected)
summary: THE TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS CERITIFICATION LABEL MAY HAVE INCORRECT INFORMATION.

title: Ford Motor Company: STRUCTURE:DOOR ASSEMBLY:LATCHES AND LOCKS (190,000 affected)
summary: WATER CAN ENTER THE DOOR LATCH RELEASE CABLE. IF THE VEHICLE IS OPERATED IN BELOW FREEZING TEMPERATURES, THE WATER IN THE DOOR LATCH RELEASE CABLE CAN FREEZE AND CAUSE THE LATCH MECHANISM TO MALFUNCTION.

title: CENTURY PRODUCTS: EQUIPMENT:CHILD SEAT (727,343 affected)
summary: THE SPANISH INSTRUCTIONS ON THE POSITIONING LABEL ARE INCORRECT.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES (283 affected)
summary: THE DOOR WIRING STRAP CAN BREAK AND PREVENT THE DOOR STEP FROM EXTENDING WHEN THE DOOR IS OPEN.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:BATTERY:CABLE (34,693 affected)
summary: THE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE CAN CHAFE BECAUSE OF ITS PROXIMITY TO THE OIL TANK, CAUSING A SHORT CIRCUIT IF THE CABLE SHOULD GROUND.

title: Jaguar Cars, Ltd.: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:WIRING:PRIMARY AND SECO (11,000 affected)
summary: THE HIGH TENSION LEAD FROM THE IGNITION COIL CAN MOVE FROM THE PRODUCTION LOCATION CLOSER TO THE #4A FUEL INJECTOR HOSE. THIS COULD LEAD TO THE OUTER AND INNER INJECTOR HOSES CRACKING OR SPLITTING FROM OZONE DETERIORATION.

title: ARVINMERITOR AUTOMOTIVE: POWER TRAIN:DRIVELINE:UNIVERSAL JOINT (123,000 affected)
summary: THE INTERAXLE DRIVELINE U-JOINTS MAY FAIL AT LOW MILEAGE DUE TO LACK OF LUBRICATION IN THE U-JOINT IN THE ASSEMBLY PROCESS.

title: Oshkosh Corporation: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (1,618 affected)
summary: THE TRANSMISSION SHIFTER ALLOWS THE VEHICLE TO REMAIN IN REVERSE GEAR EVEN THOUGH THE SHIFTER IS PLACED IN THE PARK-BRAKE POSITION IF THE OPERATOR HAS NOT PLACED THE SHIFTER INTO THE PARK-BRAKE DETENT.

title: General Motors, LLC: INTERIOR SYSTEMS:INSTRUMENT PANEL:GLOVE COMPARTMEN (95,897 affected)
summary: THE GLOVE COMPARTMENT DOOR WILL NOT REMAIN CLOSED DURING CERTAIN LOAD FORCES ASSOCIATED WITH A VEHICLE CRASH. THIS DOES NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 201.
